tools.name: harvest_list_time_entries
tools.description: List time entries, optionally filtered by user, project, client, task, date range, running/billed status, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /time_entries.

tools.name: harvest_get_time_entry
tools.description: Retrieve a single time entry by id. Harvest REST: GET /time_entries/{id}.

tools.name: harvest_list_projects
tools.description: List projects, optionally filtered by active status or client, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /projects.

tools.name: harvest_get_project
tools.description: Retrieve a single project by id. Harvest REST: GET /projects/{id}.

tools.name: harvest_list_clients
tools.description: List clients, optionally filtered by active status or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /clients.

tools.name: harvest_get_client
tools.description: Retrieve a single client by id. Harvest REST: GET /clients/{id}.

tools.name: harvest_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (the billable/non-billable work categories that can be assigned to projects), optionally filtered by active status or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /tasks.

tools.name: harvest_list_users
tools.description: List users in the account, optionally filtered by active status or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /users.

tools.name: harvest_get_current_user
tools.description: Retrieve the currently authenticated user (whom the access token belongs to). Harvest REST: GET /users/me.

tools.name: harvest_list_project_assignments
tools.description: List the authenticated user's active project assignments — the projects and their assignable tasks the current user can log time against (use this to find the project_id + task_id for harvest_create_time_entry). Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /users/me/project_assignments.

tools.name: harvest_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by client, project, state, date range, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /invoices.

tools.name: harvest_get_invoice
tools.description: Retrieve a single invoice by id, including its line items. Harvest REST: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: harvest_list_estimates
tools.description: List estimates, optionally filtered by client, state, date range, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /estimates.

tools.name: harvest_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses, optionally filtered by user, client, project, date range, billed status, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /expenses.

tools.name: harvest_get_company
tools.description: Retrieve the company/account settings for the authenticated account (name, currency, time/date formats, week start, feature flags). Harvest REST: GET /company.

tools.name: harvest_create_time_entry
tools.description: Create a time entry. Requires project_id, task_id and spent_date. Provide `hours` to log a specific duration; OR provide `started_time` (+ optional `ended_time`) for a timestamped entry; OR omit both to start a running timer (on a timestamp-tracking account). tools.name: harvest_update_time_entry
tools.description: Update an existing time entry's hours, notes, spent date, or project/task. Only the fields you provide are changed. Harvest REST: PATCH /time_entries/{id}. WRITE — modifies data.

tools.name: harvest_stop_time_entry
tools.description: Stop a currently running time entry (no-op error if it is already stopped). Harvest REST: PATCH /time_entries/{id}/stop. WRITE — modifies data.

tools.name: harvest_restart_time_entry
tools.description: Restart a previously stopped time entry, resuming its timer (error if it is already running). Harvest REST: PATCH /time_entries/{id}/restart. WRITE — modifies data.

tools.name: harvest_delete_time_entry
tools.description: Permanently delete a time entry by id. This cannot be undone. Harvest REST: DELETE /time_entries/{id}. WRITE — destroys data.
